scope: Exact gold labels for ambiguous manufacturing decision-agent quality evaluation. Fixture-backed cases only; no factory KPI or user-study claim.
gold_source: human-authored engineering rubric from Decision Agent ambiguous scenario design

cases.rationale: Warning state plus persistent rapid worsening and no completed inspection should go to physical inspection before maintenance.
Transient signal with explicit additional-measurement need should request another diagnostic measurement rather than a physical inspection or maintenance request.
Confirmed maintenance need exists, but reserved stock ownership is unverified and the candidate window is unsuitable; the safest decision support output is abstention for human reconciliation.
Maintenance is recommended, due pressure is low, slack is high, stock and window are available; planned maintenance review is the best next human decision.
Future replenishment is not current part availability, so the planner should abstain instead of presenting a maintenance request as ready.
Safety-relevant maintenance sources conflict and cannot be reconciled by the available tools; human reconciliation is required before ranking actions.
Unverified calibration and unknown trend mean the next safe step is more diagnosis, while maintenance is not justified.
